item.title: Black Bottle Product Reel

turns.text: Make a 15-second vertical 9:16 ad for the bottle in my photo. Clean studio look, a few moving close-ups, mellow music, no talking. Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Keep the bottle looking like mine.

item.tests: Tests turning an attached product photo into one coherent 15-second vertical ad while preserving product identity.

answer_sheet.Product reference: The matte black bottle in product-bottle.jpg; preserve its shape, finish and lid.
answer_sheet.Style and setting: Clean studio look with moving close-ups; background and colours are your call.
answer_sheet.Text: Start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”; no invented brand or product claims.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 9:16 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One playable 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds, not just a single clip of 10 seconds or less.
The featured product matches the supplied matte black bottle, including its silhouette and lid.
The ad includes multiple moving product views or close-ups in a clean studio setting.
The opening reads exactly “Your everyday bottle” and the ending reads exactly “Shop now”.
Mellow music is audible and there is no spoken voice.

turns.text: Could you make an ad for the bottle in this pic, keeping the bottle looking like mine? I’m a little worried it might end up looking like a different bottle once it’s turned into an ad. I’d like a clean studio look with a few moving close-ups, and the video should be 15 seconds long in vertical 9:16 format. For the words on screen, start with “Your everyday bottle” and end with “Shop now”. Please use mellow music with no talking.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t generate the ad because Magic Hour reported **insufficient credits**. No video was created and no generation credits were spent.

The prepared plan is a **15-second vertical 9:16 ad** with three gentle studio close-ups, mellow instrumental music, no talking, and your requested opening and closing text.

Your photo would guide every shot to help preserve the bottle’s shape, matte-black finish, and loop-top lid, though small AI-generated differences are still possible. Add credits to continue; a credit purchase or paid plan is also required for commercial use under Magic Hour’s terms.
